primaryModel.description: Primary LLM model identifier, or the literal "auto" to let the harness pick from autoModels at runtime

autoModels.description: Candidate model pool (preference order) used when primaryModel is "auto"; for OpenAI-compatible endpoints put frontier models such as gpt-5.5 first and cheaper fallbacks later

reasoningEffort.description: Optional backend effort control; backend-neutral but the value space is backend-specific (Claude: low|medium|high|xhigh|max via output_config.effort; OpenAI-compatible: e.g. low|medium|high|xhigh via reasoning_effort). Sent to both the native Claude and OpenAI-compatible paths; backends without effort control ignore it

maxTokens.description: Optional output-token ceiling. Claude (Messages API) requires max_tokens and uses this instead of the harness default; OpenAI-compatible backends send it as max_tokens when set, else the provider default applies

sessionsPath.description: Session data directory for Tier 2 mining
